# Rupert Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** 9-10 years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c13 P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Juneford  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Rupert has golden-glinted brown hair and unafraid, straightforward, luminous dark-blue eyes inherited from his deceased mother. He is smaller in stature than his older brother Tobias, though wider in build.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c8 P14](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0014)_

## Personality

Rupert possesses a deep curiosity and fascination with nature, animals, and insects. He is energetic, mischievous, and occasionally careless or disruptive without intending malice. Despite his adventurous and rebellious antics, he is intensely loyal to his siblings and friends, showing brave endurance when facing consequences.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c4 P57](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0057), [v5 c8 P1](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0001), [v5 c10 P21](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0021)_

## Traits

- Fascinated by insects and small animals  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>
- Mischievous and playful  <sub>[v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c8 P1](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0001)</sub>

- Curious and inquisitive  <sub>[v5 c8 P14](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0014), [v5 c8 P21](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- Capturing and observing insects and small creatures  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To explore nature and observe wildlife  <sub>[v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>
- To protect his siblings and participate in group games  <sub>[v5 c4 P57](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0057), [v5 c8 P1](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0001)</sub>

## History

Rupert relocated to Glen St. Agnes with his father, brothers, and sisters, settling at the manse. He spent much of his free time playing in Fern Hollow and the old Methodist graveyard with his siblings and the Carrow children, frequently bringing caught insects, frogs, or garter snakes into the house. After Mary Stubbs arrived at the manse, Rupert participated in various outdoor pranks, such as leaping off the henhouse roof into straw and playing in the cemetery. During one trick, he tossed an allegedly dead eel into old Mrs. Carr's buggy, scaring her into jumping out and leading his father to attempt to discipline him with a switch, though his father ultimately could not bring himself to strike Rupert. Following the incident, Rupert accepted a self-imposed Club penalty of sitting on Hezekiah Pollock's tombstone until midnight in a cold rain, which caused him to contract a severe case of double pneumonia that nearly cost him his life before he recovered.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P23](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0023), [v5 c2 P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 c4 P57](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0057), [v5 c10 P13](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0013), [v5 c10 P16](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0016), [v5 c10 P21](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0021), [v5 c10 P26](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0026), [v5 c10 P27](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Born to Rev. John Ashdown and Cecilia Ashdown in Juneford before the family moved to Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v5 c2 P23](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0023), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- Mother passed away when he was young, leaving him to grow up in the manse with his father, siblings, and Aunt Martha  <sub>[v5 c2 P23](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0023), [v5 c2 P25](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0025)</sub>
